description: Run discovery and, on hosts with a valid ownership proof, the active security tests against a remote MCP server URL; returns a Markdown summary and the full JSON report. Active tests register and delete temporary OAuth clients, send failed token requests and CONSUME the configured test grant. Only use on servers the user owns or is authorized to test, after the user confirmed. One scan at a time; it can take a minute. Without a proof, only discovery and two passive checks run.

only.description: Run only these checks: comma-separated IDs (MAP-RDR01 or RDR01) or families (RDR)

skip.description: Do not run these checks (same syntax; wins over only), e.g. THR to avoid failed token requests

url.description: The MCP endpoint URL, e.g. https://mcp.example.com/mcp

name: scan
title: Scan a remote MCP server
